mapper.insert: INSERT INTO want_see(user_id, movie_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{movieId}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, movie_id) DO NOTHING
MERGE INTO want_see KEY(user_id, movie_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{movieId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM want_see WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND movie_id = #{movieId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM want_see WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND movie_id = #{movieId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM want_see WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT movie_id FROM want_see WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
